items.title: Integrated project logistics intelligence services
items.summary: Mozambique Rovuma Venture S.p.A (MRV) invites qualified companies for “Integrated project logistics intelligence services”. The deadline shown in the official source is 30-Oct-26. Expression of interest.
items.why: The “Integrated project logistics intelligence services” opportunity has a responsible entity, a concrete action and a deadline that should be checked before applying.
items.action: Open the original notice for “Integrated project logistics intelligence services”, confirm the requirements and deadline, and prepare the requested documents.

note: Editorial radar: opportunities with an identified deadline remain visible until that date; notices without a deadline remain visible for 14 days only.
